newsitem.title: FRANCE: French woman sentenced for harassing Paco Rabanne.
newsitem.headline: French woman sentenced for harassing Paco Rabanne.

text.p: A French woman was given a one-year suspended prison sentence and ordered to pay 10,000 francs ($1,900) in damages on Monday for harassing fashion designer Paco Rabanne by accusing him of satanic powers.
Josianne Pasquier, 51, was also ordered to undergo psychiatric treatment and put on probation for three years.
Rabanne, 62, told the court last month that Pasquier regularly followed him to lunch at his favourite restaurant, shouting "Satan! Pimp! Paedophile!" or accusing him of having raped her daughter.
The French designer, who has written several books on the supernatural, said the woman also often went to his boutique, trying to dissuade clients from entering "Satan's den".
Pasquier, who did not deny the allegations, told a perplexed court that Rabanne, best-known for futuristic designs featuring metal mini-skirts and tubes, spoke to her via telepathy.
